extracted.intended_audience: editors of literary magazines and small presses (those who nominate works for Pushcart Prizes)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines for editors submitting nominations to The Pushcart Prize: Best of the Small Presses, specifying eligible genres, publication venues and timeframe, nomination limits, submission materials, deadlines, and fees. Targeted at editors nominating up to six works from their magazine or press.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligible genres
rubrics_metrics.description: Publication in The Pushcart Prize: Best of the Small Presses is awarded annually for works of poetry, fiction, and creative nonfiction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only works in the genres of poetry, fiction, and creative nonfiction are considered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligible publication venues
rubrics_metrics.description: Works must be published by literary magazines or small presses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nominations should come from editors of literary magazines or small presses that published the work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication timeframe / year of eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Works must be published (or scheduled to be published) during the current year (e.g., in 2025).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page states works published by literary magazines or small presses during the current year are eligible; it also explicitly allows works "scheduled to be published, in 2025."

rubrics_metrics.name: Who may nominate and nomination limit
rubrics_metrics.description: Editors may nominate up to six poems, short stories, novel chapters, or essays.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each editor/venue is limited to a maximum of six nominations across the eligible forms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acceptable work forms
rubrics_metrics.description: Acceptable nominations include poems, short stories, novel chapters, or essays.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These are the specific formats listed on the page; other forms are not mentioned and therefore not implied as acceptable here.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission materials required
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit one copy of each work nominated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The listing instructs editors to submit one copy of each nominated poem, story, chapter, or essay. Visit the official Pushcart website for any additional formatting or physical/digital submission instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deadline
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page lists a deadline of December 1, 2025 and notes to check back on October 15th for upcoming deadline information; verify year-specific deadlines on the official site each season.

rubrics_metrics.name: Entry fee
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nominations are free of charge according to this listing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Where to find complete guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: Visit the Pushcart Prize website for complete guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Poets & Writers listing provides a short summary and refers nominators to the official Pushcart Prize website (http://pushcartprize.com) for full submission rules, any additional eligibility details, and submission instructions.
